Coucou Bakehouse is a tiny bakery on Fulton St E in Grand Rapids, baking Basque cheesecakes, cookies, focaccia and morning buns on a menu that changes by the day.

A short day, on purpose.

Opened 18 November 2026, and sold out on day one and day two.

Coucou opens four days a week, Wednesday to Saturday, and the day runs from 9 in the morning to 3 in the afternoon, or sell out. The shop is run by a team of seven, and the menu rotates daily, so the case rarely looks the same two days in a row.

Where

1163 Fulton St E, Grand Rapids, MI 49503

When

Wednesday to Saturday, 9am to 3pm or sell out

How big

A tiny bakery, in its first permanent storefront

The rotating menu

The menu changes daily. This is a selection of what has come out of the Coucou kitchen, grouped by shelf.

Cheesecakes

the Basque shelf

  • Basque Cheesecake, Hojicha and Caramel

    Burnt top and a soft centre, roasted tea with caramel.

  • Basque Cheesecake, Ube

    The purple yam Basque, baked dark on top.

  • Biscoff Cheesecake

    Spiced biscuit through the base and the crumb.

  • Tiramisu Cheesecake

    Coffee and mascarpone in cheesecake form.

  • Earl Grey Blackberry Cheesecake

    Bergamot tea with blackberry folded through.

Cookies

five on rotation

  • Miso White Chocolate

    Savoury sweet miso against white chocolate.

  • Brown Butter Chocolate Chip

    Nutty brown butter, dark chocolate chips.

  • Biscoff

    Caramelised biscuit, in a cookie.

  • S'mores

    Chocolate, marshmallow and biscuit crumb.

  • Pandan Coconut Raspberry

    Green pandan, coconut and a raspberry centre.

Focaccia and savoury

savoury, on house focaccia

  • Salmon Everything Focaccia

    Salmon with everything seasoning on house focaccia.

  • Pancetta and Chives Focaccia

    Crisp pancetta and fresh chives.

  • Pizza Focaccia

    Hot honey, ricotta and basil on a pizza style focaccia.

  • Pesto Ham Burrata Sandwich

    A focaccia sandwich of pesto, ham and creamy burrata.

  • Mini Ham and Butter Sando

    Small, simple, ham and butter.

More from the case

buns, brownies and rolls

  • Orange and Oolong Morning Buns

    Citrus and tea in a swirled morning bun.

  • Cinnamon Roll

    The classic, warm spiced and soft.

  • Dubai Chocolate Brownies

    Rich chocolate brownies, Dubai style.

  • Tiramisu Brownie

    A brownie with a tiramisu heart.

  • Miso Banana Bread

    Banana bread with a savoury miso edge.

  • Pumpkin Tiramisu Cup

    Pumpkin and tiramisu, served in a cup.

The case turns over fast. On opening day it emptied completely, and on day two it emptied again, so the morning is the safest time to come.

Founder Joy Shin with the team and a full rack on opening week.

January 2024

A side project

Joy Shin starts selling pastries as a side project while working at a school.

2024 to 2026

Sellout pop ups

Nearly three years of pop ups follow, and they keep selling out.

The Kickstarter

$86,229

18 November 2026

Grand opening

Coucou opens at 1163 Fulton St E with a team of seven. The shop sells out on opening day, and again on day two.

Come in the morning.

Coucou Bakehouse is at 1163 Fulton St E, Grand Rapids, MI 49503. The doors open at 9 and close at 3, or earlier on a sell out day.
